newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Gazprom - Credit Lyonnais, Dresdner to arrange loan.
newsitem.headline: Gazprom - Credit Lyonnais, Dresdner to arrange loan.

text.p: Russian natural gas monopoly Gazprom said on Monday it had mandated banks Credit Lyonnais and Dresdner Kleinwort Benson to organise a bridging loan of $1.2 billion and medium term credits of $2.5 to $3 billion dollars.

Gazprom said in a statement the bridging loan would replace an earlier short-term credit, announced at the end of May but then withdrawn. Gazprom officials declined to give further details but this appeared to be a reference to a $1.2 billion credit organised by banks ABN Amro and Goldman Sachs.
